# CompactSequenceArchitectureDiscovery

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
A neuroevolution framework that automatically discovers minimal sequence-processing neural architectures by jointly optimizing topology and parameters under a compactness constraint. Enables TCC/iNEST systems to synthesize efficient in-network sequence processors without manual design, reducing resource overhead in topology-centric hardware.
